tools.name: store_385ff93e1f6a498f871c2764ec81d3be_list_products
tools.title: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: list_products
tools.description: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: A single explicit page of WooCommerce products, ordered by ID. Follow next_page to collect more. Prices are store-currency decimal strings.

tools.name: store_385ff93e1f6a498f871c2764ec81d3be_create_product
tools.title: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: create_product
tools.description: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: Create one simple product. Defaults to published/visible, decimal price in configured store currency. Require a unique SKU; never automatically retry a timed-out write. Reconcile unknown outcomes by listing that SKU.

tools.name: store_385ff93e1f6a498f871c2764ec81d3be_list_orders
tools.title: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: list_orders
tools.description: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: A single explicit page of orders (ID ascending). Optional UTC second-precision after/before form a half-open interval [after,before). Use Calendar day_range; follow next_page. Omits customer/private metadata.

tools.name: store_385ff93e1f6a498f871c2764ec81d3be_get_order
tools.title: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: get_order
tools.description: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: Get one order by its positive ID. Money and creation time are exact; customer/private metadata is omitted.

tools.name: store_385ff93e1f6a498f871c2764ec81d3be_update_order_status
tools.title: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: update_order_status
tools.description: M10 Solstice Synthetic Store · 385ff93e: Set one order to a supported WooCommerce status. Status assignment is repeatable but Woo hooks may have effects. Never automatically retry an ambiguous write; reconcile with get_order.
